handback.title: One settings file per repo over shipped defaults
handback.summary: Each repo sets only what differs from Dokima's shipped defaults, in one settings file.
handback.feature: A repo changes Dokima's behavior through one settings file. Stories: (1) the reader; (2) Dokima's own file; (3) to (5) code reads settings.

stories.context: New `dokima/settings.py` reads `dokima/defaults.yaml` and the repo's `.dokima/settings.yaml` with PyYAML (owner allowed it). Today `dokima/setup.py` `read_settings()` (line 65) reads only nested maps and `write_settings()` (line 84) rewrites the file; `dokima/agents.py` `role_settings()` reads `.dokima/agents.yml` or `DOKIMA_SETTINGS`. Workflows that use setup-python lack PyYAML: full-suite, acceptance-criteria, testmon, agent, board, uptodate, playthrough. Locked keys: app-only identity, keys only from main, fence, judge runs main's copy, owner approval by default. The defaults file also holds every key stories 3 to 5 read.

stories.context: Values today: `main` in `agent_autopilot.py`, `manifest.py`, `audit.py`, `agent_records.py`; `LOGS_BRANCH` in `agent_records.py`; AGENTS.md in `agent_checks.py`, `agent_next.py`, `agent_records.py`; `tests/` in `fence.py`, `checks.py`, `planner.py`; labels in `manifest.py` `LABELS`; checks in `manifest.py` `CHECKS`, `uptodate.py`, `card.py`; caps in `words.py` `CAPS` and `planner.py`; icons in `card.py` `icon()`. #424: `manifest.py` `check_python()` around line 297. Workflow files stay as they are (see the question).

raises.label: Settle: file name
raises.text: Should a repo's settings file end in .yaml or .yml? The plan assumes .yaml, like the defaults file.
raises.evidence: The issue asks to settle `.yml` vs `.yaml` before building.

raises.label: Doubt: workflow values
raises.text: Do workflows start reading the co-author trailer and test commands in #742 and #744? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: #742 replaces the trailer from #110; #744 runs `tests.install` and `tests.exclude` in `full-suite.yml`.

raises.label: Doubt: already fixed
raises.text: Two absorbed bugs look fixed already. Should the plan carry no work for them? It assumes so.
raises.evidence: #721 fixed by #758 (`dokima/setup.py`); #515's labels left `dokima/manifest.py` in #773; no `latest_worker_run` in `dokima/card.py`.
